instructions: Repair only the legacy Decision Packet regression exposed by RUN-258-001; preserve the failed candidate's production H2 implementation unchanged.

In test_repair_authoring_projects_runtime_failure_without_diagnostics, require bounded_observations to contain exactly phase, error and strategy_facts, and keep the legacy phase/error assertion exact rather than using an open-ended filter that could hide unrelated extra fields.

Preserve the existing private-diagnostic non-leak assertions. Do not duplicate the detailed H2 action-eligibility policy in this legacy regression; the dedicated H2 strategy-projection tests remain responsible for strategy_facts semantics.
Do not skip, xfail, delete, or broadly relax tests to obtain a green suite.
Run the canonical TASK-258 minimum-sufficient verification unchanged after the repair.

acceptance.condition: For an exact canonical failed RUN in REPAIR_AUTHORING, the Decision Packet presented to Brain Stage 1 contains the bounded H2 strategy-fact projection derived from the same TASK/FAILURE/candidate/pre-verification identities, including every minimum fact and all four structural eligibility entries required by the H2 architecture contract.

The projection distinguishes PRESENT, ABSENT and INVALID reusable pre-verification state and PRESENT, MISSING and INVALID structural ResultPackage state; malformed, stale, conflicting, identity-mismatched or incomplete canonical material cannot be silently treated as valid or as a semantic recommendation.

NO_CHANGE, FINALIZE_CANDIDATE, CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION and CODE_FIX eligibility are deterministic structural ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE facts mechanically consistent with the same Runtime action/reuse admission predicates, while no candidate_mutation_required, ranking, preferred action, default action or selected action is projected.

Producing and consuming the H2 projection is mutation-free and verification-free, and audited AUTHOR_REPAIR reconstruction binds it before Stage 1 to exact canonical inputs so mutation-edge drift of those inputs rejects the authoring handoff rather than reusing stale facts.

Existing REPAIR execution admission, authorization scope, reusable pre-verification fast path and Executor requirements retain their current authority and fail-closed behavior; structural eligibility cannot by itself create or admit a REPAIR RUN.

A canonically reviewed successful REPAIR that receives a DELTA CHANGES_REQUIRED decision can serve as the exact source of the existing AUTHOR_REMEDIATION and REMEDIATION path when its REPAIR wrapper and prior correction lineage are valid, without converting it to PRIMARY or introducing a new lifecycle kind.

Missing, malformed, moved, conflicting, ambiguous or cross-TASK successful-REPAIR lineage, incorrect failed-head/root/result-base bindings, substituted repair.json content, or an unrelated prior REVIEW is rejected before remediation authority or execution is created and cannot fall back to ordinary PRIMARY provenance.

Focused regressions cover action-neutral projection states and drift, preservation of existing REPAIR execution behavior, and successful plus adversarial successful-REPAIR-to-DELTA-CHANGES_REQUIRED-to-REMEDIATION lineage cases.

assumptions: H1 audited authoring and H1R safe local-main reconciliation are published, and H2 repair-strategy facts is the unique current roadmap NEXT commitment.

Canonical FAILURE transport, pre-verification candidate transport, existing REPAIR authorization validation and Runtime completion/admission predicates remain the engineering authorities to reuse rather than reinterpret.
A successful REPAIR remains an ordinary RUN plus exact REPAIR lineage sidecar; H2 does not create a new RUN kind or lifecycle family.

hard: The H2 projection is read-only and action-neutral: computing or consuming it must create no RUN, invoke no Executor or verification, acquire no mutation authority and mutate no repository/runtime/canonical state.

The projected contract is bounded to the architecture facts: reusable_preverification_state, structural_result_package, candidate_clean_committed, candidate_transportable, candidate_repairable, candidate_descends_from_base, outside_task_scope, acceptance_coverage, and structural eligibility for NO_CHANGE, FINALIZE_CANDIDATE, CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION and CODE_FIX.

Every projected fact must be deterministically derived from exact canonical TASK, FAILURE, failed-candidate identity and canonical transported pre-verification state; missing, malformed, stale, conflicting or identity-mismatched material must remain distinguishable without consulting chat memory, Executor claims or machine-local transient state.

Action eligibility is only a structural prerequisite expressed as ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE. It must not encode preference, ordering, semantic necessity, mutation-required judgment or an implicit correction choice.

REPAIR_AUTHORING deterministic reconstruction must inject the exact strategy-fact projection into the Decision Packet before Stage 1, and the existing audited-authoring freshness boundary must reject publication if any bound canonical input moves before mutation.

Structural eligibility policy must have one deterministic source of truth shared with or mechanically consistent with existing Runtime action/reuse admission predicates; the projection must not fork a second independently evolving eligibility policy.

Existing REPAIR execution admission and reusable pre-verification behavior remain authoritative and fail closed; H2 projection must not itself authorize execution or weaken current action-specific admission, scope, acceptance-coverage or reusable-state checks.

The successful-REPAIR lineage compatibility correction must validate the exact REPAIR sidecar and its failed RUN, failed head, root/result base, TASK, authorization and applicable prior semantic review before that reviewed successful REPAIR may act as a source for DELTA CHANGES_REQUIRED remediation.

Recognition of a successful REPAIR as a remediation source must be based on exact validated repair.json lineage and its canonical review decision, not merely on the absence of RUN.kind or the presence of a sidecar; negative tests must prove malformed or substituted wrappers cannot fall back to ordinary PRIMARY provenance.

Successful REPAIR provenance must remain distinguishable from PRIMARY and REMEDIATION provenance. Missing, malformed, conflicting, ambiguous or unrelated REPAIR lineage must fail closed rather than being treated as an ordinary source.
No H2 result may automatically advance roadmap or become independent lifecycle truth; canonical Runtime artifacts, Review decisions and Publisher state remain authoritative.

task.goal: Implement H2 by projecting exact, bounded, read-only and action-neutral REPAIR strategy facts into the REPAIR_AUTHORING Decision Packet before Brain Stage 1, and close the exact successful-REPAIR to DELTA CHANGES_REQUIRED to REMEDIATION source-lineage compatibility gap without giving Runtime semantic strategy authority.
non_goals: Let Runtime, Flow Resolver, Decision Packet compilation or deterministic eligibility code choose, rank, recommend, default or retry a REPAIR action.
Project candidate_mutation_required or any equivalent semantic conclusion about whether more implementation work is needed.
Automatically author or execute REPAIR, choose an Executor, create a RUN, invoke verification, publish, review or advance roadmap from the strategy-fact projection.
Create a new lifecycle family, correction router, planner, retry/failover loop, semantic authority, Reviewer, Publisher or persistent strategy state store.
Change frozen TASK/RUN/RESULT/EVIDENCE/REVIEW/REMEDIATION semantics or reinterpret historical terminal artifacts.
Implement H3 acceptance proof-phase authoring, H4 wake/resume hardening, H5 closure, performance work, downstream adoption or unrelated correction-flow redesign.
task.problem: REPAIR authoring currently projects the failed subject, changed files, failure phase and bounded error class, but not the deterministic pre-verification, candidate-structure, acceptance-coverage and per-action structural eligibility facts already available from canonical Runtime state. Brain therefore has to re-derive those facts outside the audited authoring packet. Separately, canonical transport can carry a successful REPAIR wrapper, but downstream remediation-source consumers do not yet treat that exact reviewed REPAIR provenance as a first-class compatible source, so a DELTA CHANGES_REQUIRED review after a successful REPAIR can lose correction lineage.
